# Far peaks: seven small seven-sided cones, jagged, their tops white with snow, rising out of the
# clouds behind the shrine (hedra y 9..15 = world z -9..-15). Faces turned away from the camera and
# the buried bases are deleted. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.1451 0.1412 0.2745 --no-slot
material new Snow --base-color 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Pk0 --vertices 7 --radius1 2.6 --radius2 0 --depth 6.4 --location -9.0 10.5 0.20
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > -0.5"
subdivide --cuts 2
select vert where "pos.z < 2.80"
randomize --amount 0.26 --seed 1
mode object
add mesh cone --name Pk1 --vertices 7 --radius1 3.2 --radius2 0 --depth 7.4 --location -6.2 13.0 0.70
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > -0.5"
subdivide --cuts 2
select vert where "pos.z < 3.30"
randomize --amount 0.32 --seed 2
mode object
add mesh cone --name Pk2 --vertices 7 --radius1 3.0 --radius2 0 --depth 7.0 --location 6.8 12.0 0.50
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > -0.5"
subdivide --cuts 2
select vert where "pos.z < 3.10"
randomize --amount 0.30 --seed 3
mode object
add mesh cone --name Pk3 --vertices 7 --radius1 2.4 --radius2 0 --depth 6.0 --location 9.5 10.0 0.00
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > -0.5"
subdivide --cuts 2
select vert where "pos.z < 2.60"
randomize --amount 0.24 --seed 4
mode object
add mesh cone --name Pk4 --vertices 7 --radius1 2.0 --radius2 0 --depth 5.6 --location -12.5 9.0 -0.20
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > -0.5"
subdivide --cuts 2
select vert where "pos.z < 2.40"
randomize --amount 0.20 --seed 5
mode object
add mesh cone --name Pk5 --vertices 7 --radius1 2.2 --radius2 0 --depth 5.6 --location 12.5 9.5 -0.20
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > -0.5"
subdivide --cuts 2
select vert where "pos.z < 2.40"
randomize --amount 0.22 --seed 6
mode object
add mesh cone --name Pk6 --vertices 7 --radius1 3.6 --radius2 0 --depth 5.3 --location 0.5 15.0 -0.35
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > -0.5"
subdivide --cuts 2
select vert where "pos.z < 2.25"
randomize --amount 0.36 --seed 7
mode object
select Pk0 Pk1 Pk2 Pk3 Pk4 Pk5 Pk6
active Pk0
join
rename Pk0 Peaks
material assign Rock
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.35"
delete only-faces
select face where "pos.z < -1.2"
delete only-faces
select face where "pos.z > 2.1 && normal.z > 0.2"
material assign Snow
mode object
shade flat
export peaks.glb
